summary: Real catalog integration testing completed. Backend 100% passing (27/27 tests). Frontend 100% passing (13/13 flows). All 85 products from user's Excel file successfully wired end-to-end. Categories (7), products (85), hampers (9) all loading correctly. Category filtering, search, sort, product detail pages, cart persistence, build hamper, and admin redirect all working perfectly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/catalog/categories returns 7 categories (nuts, dry-fruits, dates, seeds, berries, snacks, wellness)
Backend: GET /api/catalog/products returns 85 products
Backend: GET /api/catalog/products?category=nuts returns 28 products
Backend: GET /api/catalog/products?bestseller=true&limit=6 returns 6 bestseller products
Backend: GET /api/catalog/products?q=kaju returns 7 cashew products (search working)
Backend: GET /api/catalog/products?sort=price-asc returns products sorted ascending [99, 199, 299...]
Backend: GET /api/catalog/product/kaju-320-n returns full product with description, highlights, allergen_info, 3 variants, 3 images
Backend: GET /api/catalog/hampers returns 9 hampers
Backend: GET /api/catalog/hamper/royal-gold-hamper returns full hamper with tier, tags, contents, description
Backend: All previous endpoints still working (checkout/coupon, checkout/pincode, tracking, contact, enquiry, poc/*)
Frontend: Home page shows 8 category cards (7 categories + Gift Hampers card)
Frontend: Best Sellers section shows 6 real products from API (no skeleton loaders after load)
Frontend: Nav bar shows all 7 real categories (Nuts, Dry Fruits, Dates, Seeds, Berries, Snacks, Wellness) + Gift Hampers
Frontend: /category/nuts loads 28 real products with names like 'Kaju 320 N', 'Kaju 240 N', 'Badam CF', 'Pista'
Frontend: Sort dropdown on PLP works (select element with data-testid='plp-sort', price-asc sorting verified)
Frontend: /product/kaju-320-n loads with Description/Highlights/Allergen tabs, 3 variant buttons (250g/500g/1kg), Add to Cart works
Frontend: Cart persistence working - product added to cart persists across navigation to /cart
Frontend: /gift-hampers shows 9 hampers from API with tier chips
Frontend: /gift-hampers/royal-gold-hamper loads full hamper detail with Add Hamper to Cart button
Frontend: /build-hamper/products shows 85 real products to choose from (previously 13 from mockCatalog)
Frontend: Search /search?q=cashew returns 7 matching cashew products
Frontend: Admin silent redirect working - /admin redirects to /login without exposing admin surface
